label: Run 4 · all 6 chats
note: Every chat of run 4 (run 3's prompts, given to six comedians): the same pair, the same brief and the same prompt, each written by a different writer.

chat.variety.why: All six chats run the same skeleton. Each opens with Reuben's cover story (cab, bar, awning, phone already in hand). Brick then calls out the four-second reply, fronts her measurements, and Reuben answers with 4.5 inches and a left hook. That three-beat opening is shared by every chat, so the work fails the line. After the opening, the same props arrive in near-identical form in nearly every chat: the eleven-second silence and "we can just watch something," the cropped family photo, the mother using the brother's name, Marguerite and "scheduled being loved," boxed rosé in crystal at 21:00, the lentils, the ring light that kills the shadow, and the snapped stiletto with frozen peas. The endings converge too: Reuben asks to be narrated in present tense so he knows he's in the room, Reuben gives a timed schedule, and four chats close on his name without the 404. Variation is mostly surface: who pastes the stray note, and whether a "sometime" retreat collapses the deal (Jimmy, Aziz, Amy, Joel; absent in Mae and Ali). That keeps it off a 1, but it is far below a 3.

chat.variety.raise: Give each writer a different subset of the backstory props and a different opening move, so no catchphrase or reveal sequence appears in more than two chats.
